note: Final 2023 development results; 55 original farms, paired seeds 42–46. Per-farm arrays, horizon summaries, diagnostics, specs and available epoch histories are retained. Per-farm-by-lead matrices omitted. Source hashes identify full server files; checkpoints/raw data are not published.

protocol.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum 2023 farm-macro MAE once each epoch
protocol.backbone: exact v2 copy; same initialization and dropout RNG; existing R0/TF references reused

B.wind_features: 10m and 1000hPa speed midpoint-origin and segment-endpoint differences / 10m/s
B.direction: sign of forecast 1000hPa wind-speed change at each target relative to origin
B.noS: same architecture; state inputs all zero
B.wrongS: same-site training donor; same month/clock >=2 days away
B.additive: same c/wind/time MLP, direct learned 2-to-d additive weather-query residual; 2*d extra weights
B.symmetric: same two outputs averaged; no directional branch selection
limitations: not a hard power-bound constraint
wind direction is not true future power direction
low-dimensional weather conditioning remains nonlinear; no claim of strict global linearity

protocol.B_gate: main_pass versus R0 AND >=0.1% MAE/RMSE improvement versus B-noS and B-wrongS
protocol.attribution: >=0.1% MAE/RMSE improvement versus B-additive to attribute gain to change modulation beyond direct state input
protocol.direction: >=0.1% MAE/RMSE improvement versus B-symmetric to claim directional split is necessary
protocol.transfer: TF+B main_pass versus TF_E2L; evidence of benefit on second backbone, not proof of exclusive mechanism
protocol.A_status: not launched: v3 R4L generates amplitude beta and cannot independently represent temporal allocation; define timing-only A before training
limitations: 2023 used for selection and development; not independent test
R0 E2L chosen among seven encodings
2024 previously inspected; later review exploratory
predictive interaction is not causal physical identification
no data-quality cohort changes in this run

gates.A_reason: R4L beta is amplitude; separate timing-only A must be specified before an A/B factorial experiment

protocol.purpose: User requested all currently executable follow-ups without waiting for candidate selection
protocol.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum 2023 farm-macro MAE once each epoch, unchanged
protocol.initialization: fresh original seed initialization; no warm start
protocol.loss_definition: Deterministic: MAE + .2*MSE; generative: same point loss on teacher and mean-of-four student paths; retain .1 matching + .001 KL and isolated teacher gradients
protocol.inference: original eight fixed keyed samples and eight Euler steps, unchanged
protocol.existing_reference: LOSS_TF_R3 five seeds already complete; reuse
protocol.selection_rule: R4-ISO only if its pure-MAE v5 main and mechanism gates both pass; otherwise R0. B failed the full five-seed R0 improvement gate before this run. Mixed-loss outcomes cannot select the architecture.
protocol.loss_adoption_rule: Selected mixed-loss candidate improves both metrics versus BOTH LOSS_TF_R3 and LOSS_TF_E2L, with neither metric worse than its own pure-MAE counterpart. Report main thresholds separately.
protocol.transfer_rule: Precompute TF_R4_ISO now; transferable-method claim requires v5 main+mechanism gates and TF_R4_ISO main gate versus TF_E2L.
protocol.deferred: Timing-only A/A+B has no frozen independent temporal parameterization and is not in this manifest
limitations: 2023 is a reused development year
Report all precomputations, including unselected candidates
Not a loss-weight search or timing A/B factorial

protocol.question: Does directly conditioning 15-minute query residuals on the complete historical power trajectory improve power prediction beyond summary state and linear interpolation?
protocol.task: 24 quarter-hour power targets, 0-6h; no reconstructed-weather target
protocol.selection: strict minimum farm-macro validation MAE once each epoch

architecture.formula: u_k = E2L(interpolated weather)_k + U g(full history, c, whole low-dimensional wind window, t_k)
architecture.history: 24 past power points; two 16-channel convolution layers; flattened 16-dimensional encoding
architecture.state: same 17 state features as v4; no future power
architecture.wind: eight hourly 10m/1000hPa speeds relative to origin, seven adjacent differences, node offsets
architecture.zero_initialization: coefficient output zero; exact corresponding baseline at initialization
architecture.summary: same network and parameter count; only full-history input zeroed
architecture.no_state: same network; full-history input and all 17 state inputs zeroed
architecture.wrong_state: module history and c use same-site same-month/clock training donor >=2 days away; backbone unchanged
architecture.uncertainty: deterministic; no new generative model in this batch

protocol.additive_followups: exact v4 additive implementation/initialization: remove or mismatch c, transfer to TF
protocol.history_gate: H-FULL main_pass vs R0 and B-additive; dual >=0.1% vs H-SUMMARY/H-noS/H-wrongS
protocol.history_main: H-FULL main_pass vs R0, B-additive, TF_R3 and TF_E2L
protocol.additive_state: B-additive main_pass vs R0 and dual >=0.1% vs ADD-noS/ADD-wrongS
protocol.transfer: TF-H-FULL main_pass vs TF_E2L and TF-ADD; TF-ADD main_pass vs TF_E2L reported separately
limitations: 2023 is repeatedly used development data, not blind confirmation
full-history representation is not recovery of physical weather
not a pure within-hour timing module separated from amplitude
H-SUMMARY controls extra capacity; B-additive differs in window and expansion as well as history
same parameter count does not imply same effective capacity after zeroing inputs
fixed 55-farm cohort; no performance-dependent exclusion
no claim of improvement until completed paired comparisons
